hooks.text: 被冷落的旧玩具联合起来袭击新玩具，而玩家的新军团是一队绿色塑料士兵
hooks.excerpt: Your old toys, though, aren't getting along as well. They are no longer cared for and have been forgotten. So what follows next? They're going to join together against you and assault your brand-new toys, so be prepared. But never worry! You're in luck since your brand-new toys are troops of green soldiers.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 只造塔无法获胜，还要在最佳位置部署部队并主动推进敌方领地
hooks.excerpt: Tower building alone won't be sufficient to repel incoming attackers. Build up your own troops in the best feasible positions, then unleash attacks into enemy territory. Never abandon your towers, and deploy your troops in accordance with the traits of the enemy.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 创意模式提供一百多种物件，允许玩家自行设计完整塔防关卡
hooks.excerpt: A creative mode that allows you to design your own levels with over 100+ objects.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
